parsed.notes:
The About You section supplies required skills; Ideally, you have makes its items optional.
Security tooling or workflows is read literally as a cybersecurity technical practice, rather than merely industry knowledge.
The first alternative set is RAG, agents, or fine-tuning. RAG and agents are also independently requested in the optional section, so they leave that group; no singleton group is retained. The harnesses/multi-agent alternative therefore retains group number 2.
Machine learning is independently required, so the AI-or-machine-learning wording produces no retained alternative group.
Seniority follows the explicit proven-experience signal; 2+ years does not impose an upper bound of two years.
Production AI experience alone is not treated as a request for MLOps, deployment, or model serving. Role titles and regulated-industry experience are not labeled as skills.
